crossRefs.note: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul, or his house; neither is it for us…
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
translations.bsb: “What can I give you?” Laban asked. “You do not need to give me anything,” Jacob replied. “If you do this one thing for me, I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.
translations.kjv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:
translations.asv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me aught: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed thy flock and keep it.
